sections.title: 1. Identity and observed environment
sections.intro: Use your normal assessment identity only. Keep this form and its JSON draft private. Record observed versions, not the expected reference version.

fields.label: Surname
fields.help: Your family name.

fields.label: Given name
fields.help: Your given name.

fields.label: Group
fields.help: Your actual seminar group.

fields.label: Operating system
fields.help: Name and version, or UNKNOWN.

fields.label: Terminal and browser
fields.help: Record both applications actually used.

fields.label: Observed Node version
fields.help: Run node --version; enter UNKNOWN if not available.

fields.label: Observed npm version
fields.help: Run npm --version (npm.cmd --version in Windows PowerShell if npm.ps1 is blocked); UNKNOWN if unavailable.

fields.label: C03 and S03 package identities
fields.help: Record version or PACKAGE_ID from both kits. This form belongs to S03 v1.1.0.

sections.title: 2. E1 - Predict, implement and compare
sections.intro: Before running P01, read projects/P01/student/data/tasks.json. Preserve your first prediction even when wrong. Change only projects/P01/student/src/transform-tasks.js.

fields.label: Prediction before execution
fields.help: For Ada and minimum estimate 3, predict selected IDs/order, projected fields, trimmed titles, count, total and owners.

fields.label: Input and command
fields.help: Record the fixture and exact command. Use node tools/run-cli.mjs P01 --owner Ada --minimum-estimate 3.

fields.label: Actual output and evidence ID
fields.help: Paste a short result excerpt, a local evidence ID and when observed. A valid empty JSON object is not proof of the intended pipeline.

fields.label: Comparison and stage shapes
fields.help: Compare with your original prediction. Explain what value each stage consumes/returns and why the total uses selected records.

fields.label: P01 checks and allowed edit
fields.help: Record initial baseline/objective/regression and latest statuses, failed test names and the allowed one-file diff. State NOT RUN or ENVIRONMENT FAULT where appropriate. Final full check evidence can be added after the meeting.

sections.title: 3. E2 and E3 - Boundary and identity witnesses
sections.intro: A hypothesis needs a discriminating input. Predict before running node tools/observe.mjs P01. These witnesses are separate from the canonical suite.

fields.label: E2 prediction and input
fields.help: Contrast an inherited owner with an own owner and a numeric-looking estimate string with a number.

fields.label: E2 command, observation and conclusion
fields.help: Record the command, observed return/error and the contract clause. Distinguish your code from a language-level demonstration.

fields.label: E2 correction and limitation
fields.help: State the smallest needed correction or NONE WITH REASON. Explain what the two probes do not establish.

fields.label: E3 prediction and input
fields.help: Use at least two valid records. Predict input order/values, output-array identity and output-record identity.

fields.label: E3 command and observations
fields.help: Record before/after snapshots and identities. An empty result is INCONCLUSIVE for projection/record identity.

fields.label: E3 correction and limitation
fields.help: Separate array order, record identity and nested references. State what remains untested.

sections.title: 4. E4 - Bounded Gemini claim
sections.intro: Do not paste full conversations, credentials, personal records or private datasets. Agreement with Gemini is not the target; an evidence-backed rejection can earn full credit.

fields.label: Interaction state
fields.help: PENDING permits a core draft, not a final-complete submission. ACTUAL means you really used Gemini.

fields.label: Interaction context
fields.help: For ACTUAL: date and displayed model label, or MODEL LABEL UNKNOWN. For PENDING: reason and next step.

fields.label: Relevant prompt
fields.help: Ask for one bounded review, not the finished assessed implementation. For PENDING, state planned prompt or NOT YET SENT.

fields.label: One claim to assess
fields.help: Quote only the relevant claim. For offline practice, label SYNTHETIC PRACTICE - NOT GEMINI; do not misattribute it.

fields.label: Independent verification
fields.help: Give input, command/check, actual evidence and the expected discriminating behaviour. For PENDING, state what remains to be run.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.help: Choose one; UNKNOWN is legitimate when the evidence is insufficient.

fields.label: Correction
fields.help: Write a precise correction, or NONE WITH REASON.

fields.label: Limitation
fields.help: State the scope of the independent check and what it cannot establish.

sections.title: 5. P03 portfolio - Values and input mutation
sections.intro: Required work after the meeting. Preserve unsafe-generated.js. For EACH candidate claim record prediction, concrete input, command, actual observation, correction and limitation. Reject an unsupported claim rather than inventing evidence.

fields.label: Coercion evidence
fields.help: Use: prediction → reproducer/command → observed result → correction → limitation. Distinguish the unsafe artifact from the repaired safe boundary.

fields.label: Coercion verdict
fields.help: Is the particular claim supported by your witness? UNKNOWN requires an explanation.

fields.label: Inherited fields evidence
fields.help: Use: prediction → reproducer/command → observed result → correction → limitation. Distinguish the unsafe artifact from the repaired safe boundary.

fields.label: Inherited fields verdict
fields.help: Is the particular claim supported by your witness? UNKNOWN requires an explanation.

fields.label: Input mutation evidence
fields.help: Use: prediction → reproducer/command → observed result → correction → limitation. Distinguish the unsafe artifact from the repaired safe boundary.

fields.label: Input mutation verdict
fields.help: Is the particular claim supported by your witness? UNKNOWN requires an explanation.

sections.title: 7. P03 repair and verification
sections.intro: Work only in projects/P03/student/src/safe-normalizer.js. Baseline tests describe the unsafe artifact; their PASS does not certify it as safe.

fields.label: One-file diff summary
fields.help: Name changed functions and why. Confirm unchanged unsafe artifact, tests, fixtures, CLI and dependencies.

fields.label: Initial and completed check evidence
fields.help: Give initial baseline/objective/regression plus latest baseline/objective/regression/full-suite command, status and failed-test names. NOT RUN requires the precise blocker.

fields.label: Comparison and independent mutation evidence
fields.help: Record node tools/run-cli.mjs P03 and node tools/observe.mjs P03 results. A reported safeError for the mixed-type supplied fixture is expected in a defensive implementation.

fields.label: Residual limits
fields.help: Explain singleton-freeze coverage, timestamp-validation limits and any genuinely uncompleted work.

sections.title: 8. Reflection, exit state and declaration
sections.intro: At minute 60 save a core draft. Final completeness checks fields, not code correctness, authorship or Moodle submission. Export one final PDF only after the required portfolio window.

fields.label: Implementation and portfolio state
fields.help: State COMPLETE, IN PROGRESS or BLOCKED for P01 and P03 and give the next minimal action.

fields.label: Reflection
fields.help: Explain one initially plausible but incorrect inference and the evidence that changed it.

fields.label: Remaining uncertainty
fields.help: Give a specific untested case or limitation; not a generic confidence claim.

fields.label: Individual work and truthful evidence
fields.help: I identify assistance, distinguish actual observations from predictions/practice and do not represent unexecuted checks as PASS.
